title: Siege of Montauban
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Montauban", at revision 1370743622, opens: "The siege of Montauban was a siege conducted by the young French king Louis XIII from August to November 1621, against the Protestant stronghold of Montauban. This siege followed the siege of Saint-Jean-d'Angély, in which Louis XIII had succeeded against Rohan's brother Benjamin de Rohan, duc de Soubise." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3072570, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1621 siege during the Huguenot rebellions". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
